tests.assertion: test('4921全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP，魂印只隔离未答末结算验证17招已知初始面板与技能执行',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(!(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.soulId===2117))old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s,m.id,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,7200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,7200);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});
